source.source_authority: Official 30 percent public SWITCH-Basic v1 subset

model.candidate_semantics: Zero-shot CLIP image-text similarity ceiling; no SWITCH training or tuning

frozen_algorithm.video_sampling: Uniform inclusive sampling from decoded first through last frame
frozen_algorithm.goal_extraction: Extract the quoted task after flow of; fail closed when absent or ambiguous
frozen_algorithm.desired_prompt: a photograph showing the successful visible outcome after completing: {goal}
frozen_algorithm.counterfactual_prompt: a photograph where this task is not yet complete: {goal}
frozen_algorithm.baseline: Choose the candidate image with maximum cosine similarity to the desired prompt.
frozen_algorithm.successor: Choose the candidate maximizing desired-prompt cosine minus counterfactual-prompt cosine plus maximum cosine to any sampled frame from the task video.
frozen_algorithm.abstention: UNKNOWN when the goal cannot be extracted, media cannot be decoded, there are not exactly four candidate images, or model/device identity is not exact.
frozen_algorithm.truth_firewall: GT is forbidden during source parsing, media acquisition, backend selection, embedding, scoring, prediction, and provider sealing.

forbidden_after_outcome: change prompts, weights, frame count, sampling, tie break, gate, model, or cohort
train or calibrate on the opened SWITCH task
remove tasks, options, difficult device types, or decode failures
claim navigation, physical reachability, user arrival, autonomous manipulation, product benefit, or safety
claim_boundary: One fresh public real-video multiple-choice mechanism test of whether goal-conditioned counterfactual and same-scene evidence improve terminal-state selection over desired-text similarity alone. Candidate images and answer options are benchmark-provided. It does not establish online target discovery, metric approach, reachability, executed user action, real deployment, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, or safety.
